explanation: Tipping is not legally required in the UAE and many restaurant bills already include a service charge, but leaving roughly 10-15% in cash for good service is common and appreciated, especially in Dubai and Abu Dhabi's international dining scene. Because the service charge printed on a bill doesn't always reach the staff directly, many diners tip in cash even when one is listed.
local_tip: Check the bill for an existing service charge, then leave about 10-15% in cash directly to staff if you want it to reach them.

also_check.note: Tipping is not part of local custom and can confuse or mildly embarrass staff, since excellent service is already the norm.
Tipping 15-20% is expected and forms a real part of server income, not an optional extra.
Service is included by law, but rounding up or leaving small change for good service is still a polite gesture.
